data.label: Bash

data.label: AWS CLI
data.description: Amazon Web Services command line interface

data.label: head
data.description: Print the first lines of a file

data.label: stat
data.description: Show file metadata (size, mode, owner, times)

data.description: Estimate disk usage of files and directories

data.description: Search a directory tree by name, type, size, or time; -exec and -delete run commands and remove files

data.label: fd
data.description: Find files by name (fd); -x/-X run commands per match

data.description: Sort lines of text; -o writes to a file

data.label: cut
data.description: Select fields or columns from each line

data.description: Compare two sorted files line by line

data.description: Hex dump a file; -r reverses a dump back into binary

data.label: od
data.description: Dump a file in octal, hex, or other formats

data.label: sha256sum
data.description: Compute or verify SHA-256 checksums (GNU coreutils)

data.description: Strip the directory (and optionally a suffix) from a path

data.label: dirname
data.description: Strip the last component from a path

data.label: realpath
data.description: Resolve a path to its absolute canonical form

data.label: date
data.description: Print the date; with -s/--set (as root) sets the system clock

data.label: less

data.label: man
data.description: Display manual pages through a pager

data.label: env
data.description: Print the environment, or run a command in a modified one

data.description: Show running processes as a tree

data.description: Trace library calls of a process

data.description: Download files over HTTP, HTTPS, or FTP (writes files)

data.label: scp
data.description: Copy files between hosts over SSH

data.description: Control the Linux audit system and its rules

data.label: fail2ban
data.description: Ban hosts after repeated authentication failures (fail2ban-client)

data.description: Define and run multi-container Docker applications
